name: trend-detective
description: Trend Detective: Klimatrends für zwei Standorte vergleichen (NASA Space Apps).

scripts.dev:api: uv run --project apps/api uvicorn --app-dir src trend_detective.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 --reload
scripts.contracts: uv run --project apps/api python scripts/export_openapi.py && pnpm --filter @trend-detective/contracts run generate
scripts.check:api: uv --directory apps/api run ruff check . && uv --directory apps/api run ruff format --check . && uv --directory apps/api run mypy && uv --directory apps/api run pytest
scripts.check: pnpm run check:api && pnpm --recursive --if-present run check
